tools.name: cancel_standing_order
tools.description: Cancels a customer's standing order so that no more payments will be made from it, and removes the order from the account. It also adds a cancellation entry to the account's activity history.

params.name: standing_order_id
params.description: ID of the standing order to cancel.

params.name: account_id
params.description: ID of the account that owns the standing order.

params.name: reason
params.description: Short reason for the cancellation, saved to the account history.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/bank/core.db"


def cancel_standing_order(standing_order_id: str, account_id: str, reason: str = "customer request") -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "DELETE FROM standing_orders WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?",
        (standing_order_id, account_id),
    )
    deleted = cur.rowcount
    event_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO account_history (id, account_id, event_type, reference_id, note, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (event_id, account_id, "standing_order_cancelled", standing_order_id, reason, now),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {
        "standing_order_id": standing_order_id,
        "account_id": account_id,
        "cancelled": deleted > 0,
        "history_event_id": event_id,
        "cancelled_at": now,
    }

tools.name: add_joint_account_holder
tools.description: Looks up a bank account and an existing customer, then makes that customer a joint holder of the account with the access level you choose (view-only or full). Returns the account's updated list of holders.

params.name: account_id
params.description: ID of the account to add the holder to.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: ID of the existing customer who will become a joint holder.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("bank-accounts")

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/bank/core.db"


def _connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn


@mcp.tool()
def add_joint_account_holder(account_id: str, customer_id: str, access_level: str) -> dict:
    level = access_level.strip().lower()
    if level not in ("view", "full"):
        raise ValueError("access_level must be 'view' or 'full'")
    conn = _connect()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    account = cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, product_type, status FROM accounts WHERE id = ?",
        (account_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    customer = cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, full_name FROM customers WHERE id = ?",
        (customer_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if account is None or customer is None:
        conn.close()
        raise LookupError("account or customer not found")
    granted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO account_holders (account_id, customer_id, role, access_level, granted_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, 'joint', ?, ?) "
        "ON CONFLICT(account_id, customer_id) DO UPDATE SET role = 'joint', access_level = excluded.access_level, granted_at = excluded.granted_at",
        (account_id, customer_id, level, granted_at),
    )
    conn.commit()
    holders = cur.execute(
        "SELECT h.customer_id, c.full_name, h.role, h.access_level FROM account_holders h "
        "JOIN customers c ON c.id = h.customer_id WHERE h.account_id = ? ORDER BY h.granted_at",
        (account_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    return {
        "account_id": account["id"],
        "product_type": account["product_type"],
        "added_holder": {"customer_id": customer["id"], "name": customer["full_name"], "access_level": level},
        "granted_at": granted_at,
        "holders": [dict(h) for h in holders],
    }

tools.name: transfer_between_accounts
tools.description: Moves money from one of the customer's bank accounts to another, taking it out of the source account and putting it into the destination. Fails if the source account has too little money available.

params.name: from_account_id
params.description: Account the money is taken from.

params.name: to_account_id
params.description: Account the money is paid into.

params.name: memo
params.description: Optional note shown on both statements.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/bank/core.db"


@tool
def transfer_between_accounts(from_account_id: str, to_account_id: str, amount_cents: int, memo: str = "") -> dict:
    """Transfer money between two of the customer's bank accounts."""
    transfer_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "UPDATE accounts SET available_cents = available_cents - ? WHERE id = ? AND available_cents >= ?",
            (amount_cents, from_account_id, amount_cents),
        )
        if cur.rowcount != 1:
            raise ValueError("insufficient funds or unknown source account")
        cur.execute(
            "UPDATE accounts SET available_cents = available_cents + ? WHERE id = ?",
            (amount_cents, to_account_id),
        )
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO ledger_entries (transfer_id, account_id, amount_cents, memo, posted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?), (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (transfer_id, from_account_id, -amount_cents, memo, now, transfer_id, to_account_id, amount_cents, memo, now),
        )
    return {"transfer_id": transfer_id, "amount_cents": amount_cents, "posted_at": now}

tools.name: delete_saved_payee
tools.description: Permanently removes a saved payee from a customer's address book so it can't be picked for future payments. The deletion can't be undone.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: ID of the customer who owns the payee.

params.name: payee_id
params.description: ID of the saved payee to remove.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true to confirm the permanent deletion.
